title: SearchSnippet/get loads all articles from all groups into memory
description: server.rs SearchSnippet/get arm calls list_all_articles() which returns every (group, article_num, cid) tuple in the entire database into a HashMap in memory. This is done for every SearchSnippet/get call. At scale (millions of articles) this is a very large allocation. Fix: look up the group+num for only the emailIds in the request rather than loading the entire corpus.
